data.one_liner: Create animated text and background colors for appbars when scrolled.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter library that helps you create animated text and background colors inside an app bar based on scroll position. It provides a simple widget-based approach to add dynamic visual changes to your app bar.
use_when: You want to animate app bar background colors on scroll.
You want to animate app bar text on scroll.
avoid_when: You need complex physics-based motion outside of standard scroll reactions.
strengths: Easy to use with a simple API.
Helps create dynamic scroll-based app bar animations.
weaknesses: Very specific feature set focused only on app bar color and text animation.
